authority.applicability: INT-01 ONLY; select research study model's action likelihood computation / model reference operator, not retroactive publisher erratum or automatic science admission

identities.selected_research_primary_media: User-saved official ScienceDirect complete HTML MHT

main_anchors.task_set_uncertainty_and_lapse: L107: sum task-set chosen-action probability weighted by PTS_2[:,c_2], then (1-epsilon)+epsilon/4
main_anchors.compressed_policy_paths: L123-126: same probability procedure for each compressed Q
main_anchors.policy_class_mixture: L128-130: p_policies_softmax weighted sum of two compressed and one full hierarchical choice probabilities
main_anchors.observed_action_loglikelihood: L133-136: fallback full choice policy and llh += log(pchoice_2)

order: Compute trial-specific task-set choice Q values, masking previously attempted actions per author code
For each task-set, compute softmax(beta_2 * task-set action Q vector) over current action set
Marginalize the observed action's conditional softmax probability over context-indexed task-set posterior PTS_2[:, c_2]
Apply exploration-lapse mixture to each full/compressed choice probability: (1-epsilon)*marginal + epsilon/4 in the original four-action implementation
If meta_learning active, combine two compressed and one hierarchical full policy choice probabilities with p_policies_softmax, otherwise use hierarchical full only
Accumulate log chosen-action probability for each observed trial and return negative sum
adopted_model_operator.math_literal_for_four_actions: p_k(a|s,c)=(1-epsilon) * sum_i w_i(c) * softmax(beta_2 * Q_{k,i}(s,all_actions))[a] + epsilon/4; p(a|s,c)=sum_{k in {compress1,compress2,full}} omega_k * p_k(a|s,c) (if meta_learning else full); NLL=-sum_t ln(p_t(a_t|s_t,c_t))
adopted_model_operator.omega_definition: p_policies_softmax normalized policy-class posterior used when meta_learning is on
adopted_model_operator.code_authority_over_researcher_derived_f: For edge cases, exact historical cited modeling.py file and algorithm branch ordering prevail. Do not improvise a corrected paper equation.

printed_publisher_record.location: ScienceDirect published Methods §2.3.4 marginal likelihood, §2.3.1 task-set value definition
printed_publisher_record.issue: Printed likelihood can be read as weight*TS_i raw task-set action value without explicit softmax or epsilon and therefore differs from the adopted code-defined selection probability.
